'''Darcc's Palace''' was a [[Imperial Palace (Monument)|Palace]] constructed on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] for [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Hindane Darcc/Legends|Darcc]] after the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established him as Moff of the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]]. The Palace was constructed in Darcc's [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on a cliff near the city of [[Chenachochan]]. The Palace was [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|destroyed]]<ref name="GB" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> by a group of rebelling [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] led by [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his good friend, the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. Darcc escaped capture or death, however.<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Moff Darcc's Palaces must be destroyed in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' during the Chewbacca campaign.<ref name="GB" /> The campaign and thus Palace also appears in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''.
